requirements_checklist.evidence: src/openCodePricing.ts calcOpenCodeCredits() wired via applyUsage() in openCodeSession.ts
openCodeSession.ts persist() emits traceEvents 'trace:update'/'trace:done', bridged to Socket.io in webServer.ts (unchanged mechanism)
installOpenCodePlugin() writes only ~/.config/opencode/plugins/copilot-tracer.js, no merge with other files
new routes/modules are additive; no existing OTLP/ACP code path modified
turnKey/toolKey idempotency maps in openCodeSession.ts; unknown events ignored in handleOpenCodeHook default case; malformed body handled by error middleware (verified via curl, returns 204)
resolveProject() returns undefined when no directory/repo; createSession(sessionId, undefined) records session with no project
per-sessionId maps (activeBySession, turnsByKey) keep concurrent sessions independent

findings_resolved_during_review.description: detectRepoUrl() shelled out to `git remote get-url origin` with cwd set to client-supplied directory (config-driven command execution risk); replaced with a plain-text .git/config parser.
turnForTool() had a redundant/dead conditional branch; simplified.
Convergence finding: project resolution used path-only ensureProject(), not repo-URL-preferring resolution like otlpReceiver.ts; fixed (T025).

open_low_severity_notes.note: resetOpenCodeTracker() in src/openCodeSession.ts has no external caller (no test framework exists in this repo to invoke it); kept as a documented test-only utility mirroring the pattern intended for a future test harness.
